answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 38065 Country: India Title: Walimah without having sex Question: Some of my friends says that it is necessary to have sex on the frist night, otherwise walima will not be valid. Please guide me. Answer ID: 38065 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 685/574/B=1433) Having sex in the first night is not necessary to get the walima valid. Walima is valid even without having sex. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
